content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Define respiration and explain why it is essential for life
Write the word and symbol equations for aerobic respiration
Describe where aerobic respiration occurs in cells
Explain the importance of ATP as an energy currency
is a chemical process that releases energy from glucose. It occurs in all living cells, all the time. This energy is essential for all life processes.
uses oxygen and is the most efficient way to release energy from glucose.
= chemical reactions that break down glucose to release energy
NOT the same as breathing (that's ventilation)
Moving air in and out of lungs
O₂ and CO₂ moving across surfaces
Have large surface area (inner membrane folded)
